messages:
csm_jules: FYI — OpalWave (beta cohort B) onboarding is Wed 10am PT. We still have 7 seats unclaimed and one customer exec who flagged budget concerns; possible renewal risk if we don’t surface quick wins.

ae_mike: Thanks Jules. Are the unclaimed seats legit (wrong emails) or just no-shows?

csm_jules: Mix — 3 wrong emails (typo), 2 pending SSO, 2 not scheduled. I emailed the stakeholder earlier; they replied asking for concrete ROI examples.

pm_renata: Can we assemble a 15-min demo + ROI deck focused on latency/cost saving from Redwood Optimize? I can draft, just need usage numbers.

csm_jules: Yep — I can pull per-route token usage for OpalWave from Console. Sam, can you attach the onboarding checklist and the quick ROI snippet? :pray:

onboard_sam: Uploaded the checklist to the customer folder: https://redwood.company/drive/opalwave/onboard-checklist. Quick ROI snippet below:
```
Avg tokens/day: 12k
Estimated cost w/o batching: $0.012/token -> $144/day
Estimated cost w/ suggested batching+caching: $0.006/token -> $72/day
Estimated monthly save: ~$2k
```

csm_jules: Nice — that’s exactly the language the sponsor wants. Also recommend we run an NPS micro-survey after the demo (1 question) to capture sentiment for renewals.

ae_mike: I'll schedule the demo Fri 9am PT and invite the exec. Do we have a pre-demo checklist?

onboard_sam: Yep — short checklist: confirm SSO seats, import sample prompts, verify streaming responses, run sample eval set. I pushed a tiny script to automate the sample eval:
```bash
python tools/run_eval.py --customer opalwave --suite quick-win
```

pm_renata: I can own the ROI slides + 3 bullet “what success looks like” outcomes. Will tag you both in the draft by EOD Thu.

csm_jules: Action items: Mike schedule demo, Sam fix 3 typos + confirm SSO, Renata draft deck, I'll run the micro-survey and pull Console telemetry. If anyone runs into blockers ping me. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: invite created for opalwave-exec@opalwave.com (one-time link, expires in 72h)

csm_jules: Thanks bot. Follow-up: if exec asks about renewals, use the monthly-savings + 3 product wins frame. I'll capture outcome in Gains/Losses board after the demo.

ae_mike: Got it. Scheduling invite now.

onboard_sam: I'll scrub the seat list and post the fixed CSV here once done.

csm_jules: Great — will close the loop after demo. Keeping this thread as the single source next steps.
